description: This PHP source file defines the Store class within the Opencart namespace, specifically for managing store data such as retrieving store details by ID or hostname, and fetching all stores from the database with caching support.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: A model class that handles store data retrieval from the database, including fetching store info by ID, hostname, and listing all stores with caching.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves store information based on the store ID. If ID is 0, returns default store info from config; otherwise, queries the database.

methods.name: getStoreByHostname
methods.description: Retrieves store information based on the store's hostname URL by querying the database.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Returns a list of all stores, utilizing caching to improve performance.
